social_formats.description: Social gathering and performance in ethnic clubs and union halls.

music_profile.sound_description: A driving, swinging polka rhythm anchored by drums, bass, and rhythmic strumming from a guitar or banjo. The melody and harmony feature rich accordion voicings—often from a diatonic button box or piano accordion—intertwined with fluid runs from a clarinet or saxophone. Early jazz piano influence gives the traditional polka meter a distinct swing feel.
music_profile.vocal_style: songs sung in English translated from original Slovene
